arguments.summary: Draft synthesis: completed-session technical strength and historical profitability differentiate the names, but unresolved critical valuation, macro-policy, geopolitical exposure, and (for QQQ) current-composition evidence require insufficient-evidence assessments for every instrument. The independent risk view is incorporated: momentum is descriptive, and common technology-factor exposure is qualified rather than assumed.

claims.text: ANET, MU, META and NVDA each reported positive operating income and operating cash flow in their latest normalized filings, but their reported periods differ and the record contains neither observed company market multiples nor forward earnings inputs.

QQQ's sponsor profile reported 103 holdings and a 30.08 aggregate P/E as of 2026-08-31, while the supplied holdings snapshot dated 2026-09-12 is explicitly stale and showed NVDA, MU and META weights of 8.45%, 4.85% and 3.07%, respectively.

Observed relative strength differentiates ANET and META positively, MU as a volatile rebound, NVDA as mixed versus XLK at 21 sessions, and QQQ as short-term firm but weaker over 63 sessions; these observations do not establish continuation or reversal over the stated horizon.

A common technology/risk-appetite channel remains a material qualifier: technology strength coincided with weaker completed 21-session returns in IWM and HYG, and dated QQQ holdings overlap NVDA, MU and META. This is not a measured correlation or current portfolio exposure.

If future policy/rates evidence signals tighter financial conditions or a verified trade restriction, common valuation and affected-issuer risk could outweigh the differentiated technical snapshots; easing conditions or benign policy could have the opposite effect. Neither is a supported baseline.

gaps.description: No observed company market multiples, supported forward earnings, or issuer-specific valuation sensitivity inputs permit company scenario valuation for ANET, MU, META, or NVDA.
QQQ's holdings snapshot is stale, so current composition and look-through concentration cannot be assessed.
Current policy-rate/Treasury/credit-spread observations and substantive FOMC content are unavailable; macro regime cannot be established.
Operative policy text and inspectable issuer disclosures do not quantify cross-border revenue, export-control restrictions, or supply-chain concentration.
Commodities coverage was omitted because no direct commodity channel was established in the available source set and budget was reserved for core roles.

assumptions: Completed-session split-adjusted price data are descriptive, not forecasts.
Historical SEC profitability does not establish forward durability.
QQQ dated holdings are candidate fund overlap only, not current allocation or economic dependence.
arguments.counter_thesis: Reported profitability and favorable technical positioning for several issuers may prove more relevant than missing macro and policy inputs over 21/63 sessions, while QQQ's 103 holdings may moderate idiosyncratic effects. The record cannot assess valuation asymmetry or confirm current fund composition.

review_conditions.description: Reassess all company theses when observed valuation inputs, forward-demand disclosures, substantive macro releases, and relevant policy/issuer-risk disclosures are available.
Refresh sponsor holdings before relying on QQQ look-through.

objections.description: Historical margins do not support an investability or valuation conclusion without observed market valuation, normalized/forward earnings, and sensitivity assumptions.
QQQ look-through uses a holdings table explicitly marked stale; current constituent weights and exposure cannot be assumed.
Momentum, distance from moving averages, RSI, volatility and drawdown are descriptive statistics, not evidence of a 21/63-session reversal or continuation.
A common technology/AI risk mechanism is plausible but unproven from the supplied evidence; business-level demand linkage, policy exposure, and supply-chain evidence are absent.

dispositions.reason: No observed company multiple, forward earnings basis, or valuation sensitivity was obtained.
The only supplied holdings table remains flagged stale.
Technical findings explicitly retain the descriptive limitation and do not convert indicators into forecasts.
Macro and geopolitical work could establish only contingent channels; issuer-level linkage remains unquantified.

question_effects.reason: It established historical issuer profitability/cash-flow differentiation and dated QQQ overlap, but also confirmed critical catalyst and valuation gaps.
It identified a plausible common discount-rate/risk-appetite channel but could not establish the current macro regime.
It differentiated completed technical trends and supplied review conditions without supporting a forecast.
It established that geopolitics remains contingent rather than a verified current driver.
The completed macro answer qualified technology strength as narrow-leadership context rather than broad risk confirmation.
The filing review could not inspect relevant disclosures or verify exposure figures.
